sections.title: A website you can change by asking
sections.text: This is your new site. Open it in the Brease editor and tell the AI what you want: new texts, new pages, a different look. You review every change before it goes live.

items.title: Edit the texts
items.text: Click any text on the page in the editor and change it. Your changes are saved as a draft until you publish them.

items.title: Add pages
items.text: Ask for a new page, such as Services or Pricing, and the AI builds it in the same style as the rest of the site.

items.title: Change the design
items.text: Colors, fonts and layouts can change too. Describe what you want and preview it before anyone else sees it.

sections.title: Ready to make it yours?
sections.text: Replace this text with a sentence about you or your business.
